db:info.db:title: TrailingRequiresExample Class
db:info.db:titleabbrev: Test for C++20 concepts and requires clauses

db:abstract.db:para: A class demonstrating functions with trailing requires clauses.

db:section.db:title: Detailed Description
db:section.db:para: Trailing requires clauses appear after the function declaration, rather than after the template parameter list.

db:section.db:title: template <typename T> requires detail::is_integral<T>::value T TrailingRequiresExample::combine(T a, T b) requires (sizeof(T) <= 4)
db:section.db:para: Combines a and b with both template-head and trailing requires.
This demonstrates a function with requires clauses in both positions, which is rare but valid C++20 syntax. Both constraints must be satisfied.

db:section.db:title: template <typename T> T TrailingRequiresExample::process(T value) requires detail::is_integral<T>::value
db:section.db:para: Processes value with a trailing requires clause.
The trailing requires clause appears after the function signature, which is an alternative syntax to placing it after the template parameter list.

db:section.db:title: template <typename T> double TrailingRequiresExample::transform(T input) requires detail::is_floating<T>::value
db:section.db:para: This demonstrates that trailing requires clauses work with any constraint expression.
